fault_injection.method: rail-faults.py (below) patches the generated per-domain copies of scratch trees. On Attention GPUs outside the last domain, the last domain's dispatch puts and finish tails wait until the end of the channel (3 ms globaltimer spin), and its combine replies and signal until after the channel's own wait (600 us on domain 0, 300 us elsewhere); domain 0's Attention GPUs also wait 1 ms after signalling before their combine wait (v4), so domain 1's next dispatch lands while domain 0 still waits, reads its replies and stages them. pos is the shipped protocol; control is pos with the Attention rail barrier halves restored; neg-words puts combine signals back on the dispatch tails' words; neg-reply keeps every rank's reply inbox (and the epilogue's pointer) at DeepEP's offset; neg-staging keeps the combine staging at DeepEP's offset. At FP8 DeepEP's reply inbox and staging do not reach the dispatch inbox (the combine scale-up inbox reserves U regions), so the reply and staging controls need BF16.

fault_injection.patch_script:
"""rail-faults.py <tree> <pos|neg-words|neg-reply|neg-staging>: deferred-put fault injection for Attention rails
without entry barriers (per-domain FFN prefix). Scratch only, never shipped.

Patches the generated per-domain copies of a scratch tree. In every mode, on Attention GPUs outside the last
NVLink domain, the last domain's dispatch puts and finish tails wait until the end of the channel behind a 3 ms
globaltimer spin, and its combine replies and signals until after the channel's own wait behind a 300 us spin
(the section 11 patches, with a runtime fault domain). One destination then lags while the others move on:
- pos: the protocol as shipped. Must pass.
- neg-words: combine signals share the dispatch tails' words again. Must fail (hang or mismatch).
- neg-reply: every rank's reply inbox stays at DeepEP's offset. Must fail where it overlaps the dispatch inbox.
- neg-staging: every rank's combine staging stays at DeepEP's offset. Must fail with three or more domains.
v4: domain 0 also waits 1 ms after signalling and defers its replies 600 us instead of 300 us, so with
three or more domains domain 1's next dispatch (tails, payload) lands while domain 0 still waits, reads its
replies and stages them.
Every deferral prints "AFDEP_FAULT_MARK <tag>" at 1, 2, 4, 8, ... events per process.
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

tree, mode = Path(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2]
assert mode in ("pos", "neg-words", "neg-reply", "neg-staging"), mode
impls = tree / "afdep/third_party/deepep_v2/deep_ep/include/deep_ep/impls"


def patch(name, old, new):
    path = impls / name
    text = path.read_text()
    assert text.count(old) == 1, (name, text.count(old), old[:90])
    path.write_text(text.replace(old, new))


HELPERS = '''namespace deep_ep::elastic {

// FAULT INJECTION (scratch only, rail-faults.py)
static __device__ unsigned long long afd_fault_events = 0;
__device__ __forceinline__ void afd_fault_spin(const unsigned long long ns) {
    unsigned long long t0, t;
    asm volatile("mov.u64 %0, %%globaltimer;" : "=l"(t0));
    do { asm volatile("mov.u64 %0, %%globaltimer;" : "=l"(t)); } while (t - t0 < ns);
}
__device__ __forceinline__ void afd_fault_mark(const char* tag, const int rank) {
    const auto n = atomicAdd(&afd_fault_events, 1ull) + 1;
    if ((n & (n - 1)) == 0)
        printf("AFDEP_FAULT_MARK %s rank=%d events=%llu\\n", tag, rank, n);
}
'''

D = "afdep_domain_hybrid_dispatch.cuh"
patch(D, "namespace deep_ep::elastic {\n", HELPERS)
patch(D, "        int stored_scaleout_tail = 0, stored_old_scaleout_tail = 0;\n",
      "        int stored_scaleout_tail = 0, stored_old_scaleout_tail = 0;\n"
      "        // FAULT: defer the last domain's puts and tails to the end of the channel.\n"
      "        const int fault_domain = scaleout_rank_idx == kNumScaleoutRanks - 1 ? -1 : kNumScaleoutRanks - 1;\n"
      "        int fault_phase = 0;  // 0/1: skip the delayed lane; 2: only the delayed lane\n"
      "        int deferred_token[32], deferred_slot[32], num_deferred = 0;\n")
patch(D, "            if (lane_idx < kNumScaleoutRanks and (not kAfdDirectional or lane_idx < kAfdFfnScaleoutRanks) and\n",
      "            const bool fault_lane = lane_idx == fault_domain;\n"
      "            if ((fault_phase == 2 ? fault_lane : not fault_lane) and\n"
      "                lane_idx < kNumScaleoutRanks and (not kAfdDirectional or lane_idx < kAfdFfnScaleoutRanks) and\n")
patch(D, "            if (stored_dst_slot_idx >= 0 and stored_dst_scaleout_rank_idx != scaleout_rank_idx) {\n"
         "                gin.put<ncclTeamTagRail>(\n",
      "            if (stored_dst_slot_idx >= 0 and stored_dst_scaleout_rank_idx == fault_domain) {\n"
      "                if (num_deferred < 32) { deferred_token[num_deferred] = token_idx; deferred_slot[num_deferred] = stored_dst_slot_idx; }\n"
      "                ++ num_deferred;\n"
      "            } else if (stored_dst_slot_idx >= 0 and stored_dst_scaleout_rank_idx != scaleout_rank_idx) {\n"
      "                gin.put<ncclTeamTagRail>(\n")
patch(D, "        // Flush unflushed tails\n        update_scaleout_tail(true);\n",
      "        // Flush unflushed tails (FAULT: on-time domains first, then the delayed one)\n"
      "        fault_phase = 1;\n"
      "        update_scaleout_tail(true);\n"
      "        if (fault_domain >= 0) {\n"
      "            afd_fault_spin(3000000);\n"
      "            EP_DEVICE_ASSERT(num_deferred <= 32);\n"
      "            for (int k = 0; k < num_deferred; ++ k)\n"
      "                gin.put<ncclTeamTagRail>(\n"
      "                        scaleout_recv_buffer.get_token_buffer(deferred_slot[k]).get_base_ptr(),\n"
      "                        scaleout_send_buffer.get_token_buffer(deferred_token[k]).get_base_ptr(),\n"
      "                        tma_buffer.get_num_bytes<false>(), fault_domain, ncclGinOptFlagsAggregateRequests);\n"
      "            // Warp-uniform: num_deferred is per lane, so no lane-divergent elect.\n"
      "            if (__any_sync(0xffffffffu, num_deferred > 0) and channel_idx == 0 and lane_idx == 0)\n"
      "                afd_fault_mark(\"dispatch\", rank_idx);\n"
      "            __syncwarp();\n"
      "        }\n"
      "        fault_phase = 2;\n"
      "        update_scaleout_tail(true);\n")

C = "afdep_domain_hybrid_combine.cuh"
patch(C, "namespace deep_ep::elastic {\n", HELPERS)
patch(C, "        void* last_send_token_buffer_ptr = nullptr;\n",
      "        void* last_send_token_buffer_ptr = nullptr;\n"
      "        // FAULT: defer replies and signals to the last domain until after this channel's wait.\n"
      "        const int fault_domain = (afd_holder or scaleout_rank_idx == kNumScaleoutRanks - 1) ? -1 : kNumScaleoutRanks - 1;\n"
      "        void* deferred_recv[64]; void* deferred_send[64]; int num_deferred = 0;\n")
patch(C, "                if (last_src_scaleout_rank_idx != scaleout_rank_idx) {\n",
      "                if (last_src_scaleout_rank_idx == fault_domain) {\n"
      "                    if (num_deferred < 64) { deferred_recv[num_deferred] = last_recv_token_buffer_ptr; deferred_send[num_deferred] = last_send_token_buffer_ptr; }\n"
      "                    ++ num_deferred;\n"
      "                } else if (last_src_scaleout_rank_idx != scaleout_rank_idx) {\n")
signal_new = ("afdep_domain_combine_signal_ptr(workspace_layout, channel_idx, scaleout_rank_idx)" if mode != "neg-words"
              else "workspace_layout.get_scaleout_channel_signaled_tail_ptr(channel_idx, scaleout_rank_idx)")
patch(C, "            if (afd_signal) {\n",
      "            if (afd_signal and lane_idx != fault_domain) {\n")
# v4: domain 0's Attention GPUs wait late, after signalling, so domain 1's next dispatch (not deferred)
# (tails, payload) can land while they still wait for and read this combine's signals and replies.
patch(C, "            // Wait tail arrival\n",
      "            if (not afd_holder and scaleout_rank_idx == 0)\n"
      "                afd_fault_spin(1000000);\n"
      "            // Wait tail arrival\n")
patch(C, "        __syncwarp();\n    }\n\n    // No barrier at epilogue\n",
      "        __syncwarp();\n"
      "        if (fault_domain >= 0) {\n"
      "            // v3: domain 0 lags its deferred replies longest, so a peer's next dispatch lands first.\n"
      "            afd_fault_spin(scaleout_rank_idx == 0 ? 600000 : 300000);\n"
      "            if (ptx::elect_one_sync()) {\n"
      "                EP_DEVICE_ASSERT(num_deferred <= 64);\n"
      "                for (int k = 0; k < num_deferred; ++ k)\n"
      "                    gin.put<ncclTeamTagRail>(deferred_recv[k], deferred_send[k], token_layout.get_num_bytes<false>(),\n"
      "                                             fault_domain, ncclGinOptFlagsAggregateRequests);\n"
      "                if (num_deferred > 0 and channel_idx == 0)\n"
      "                    afd_fault_mark(\"combine\", scaleout_rank_idx * kNumScaleupRanks + scaleup_rank_idx);\n"
      "            }\n"
      "            __syncwarp();\n"
      "            if (lane_idx == fault_domain)\n"
      "                gin.red_add_rel<ncclTeamTagRail>(\n"
      f"                    {signal_new},\n"
      "                    math::pack2<int, int64_t>(1, 0), lane_idx);\n"
      "            __syncwarp();\n"
      "        }\n"
      "    }\n\n    // No barrier at epilogue\n")
if mode == "neg-words":
    text = (impls / C).read_text()
    old = "afdep_domain_combine_signal_ptr(workspace_layout, channel_idx, "
    assert text.count(old) == 2, text.count(old)
    text = text.replace("afdep_domain_combine_signal_ptr(workspace_layout, channel_idx, scaleout_rank_idx)",
                        "workspace_layout.get_scaleout_channel_signaled_tail_ptr(channel_idx, scaleout_rank_idx)")
    text = text.replace("afdep_domain_combine_signal_ptr(workspace_layout, channel_idx, lane_idx)",
                        "workspace_layout.get_scaleout_channel_signaled_tail_ptr(channel_idx, lane_idx)")
    (impls / C).write_text(text)
if mode == "neg-reply":
    patch(C, "    scaleout_recv_buffer = layout::BufferLayout<false>(\n"
             "        token_layout, kNumTokensInScaleoutLayout, kNumMaxTokensPerRank,\n"
             "        math::advance_ptr(afd_scaleout_send_base, -scaleout_recv_buffer.get_num_bytes()));\n",
          "    // FAULT neg-reply: the reply inbox stays at DeepEP's offset.\n")
    host = tree / "afdep/third_party/deepep_v2/csrc/kernels/elastic/combine.hpp"
    text = host.read_text()
    a = ("        AfdepDomainHybridCombineRuntime::launch(domain_runtime, args, stream);\n"
         "        return afdep_mixed_reply_buffer(afd_scaleout_send_base, token_layout, num_scaleout_ranks,\n"
         "                                        num_max_tokens_per_rank, num_topk, allow_multiple_reduction);\n")
    b = ("        AfdepDomainHybridCombineRuntime::launch(domain_runtime, args, stream);\n"
         "        // FAULT neg-reply: the reduce epilogue reads the reply inbox at DeepEP's offset too.\n"
         "        return get_hybrid_reduce_buffer(buffer, token_layout, num_scaleout_ranks, num_scaleup_ranks,\n"
         "                                        num_max_tokens_per_rank, num_topk, allow_multiple_reduction);\n")
    assert text.count(a) == 1, text.count(a)
    host.write_text(text.replace(a, b))
if mode == "neg-staging":
    patch(C, "    scaleout_send_buffer = layout::BufferLayout<false>(\n"
             "        token_layout, kAllowMultipleReduction ? 1 : kNumTopk, kNumChannels * (kNumScaleoutRanks * kNumMaxTokensPerChannel),\n"
             "        afd_scaleout_send_base);\n"
             "    scaleout_recv_buffer = layout::BufferLayout<false>(\n",
          "    // FAULT neg-staging: the combine staging stays at DeepEP's offset.\n"
          "    scaleout_recv_buffer = layout::BufferLayout<false>(\n")
print("fault", mode, "patched", tree)
fault_injection.control_patch:
"""fctl-patch.py <tree>: on a rail-faults tree, give Attention GPUs their rail barrier halves back (control)."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

impls = Path(sys.argv[1]) / "afdep/third_party/deepep_v2/deep_ep/include/deep_ep/impls"
for name in ("afdep_domain_hybrid_dispatch.cuh", "afdep_domain_hybrid_combine.cuh"):
    p = impls / name
    t = p.read_text()
    old = "/* afdEP per-domain: no rail half (afdep_roles.hpp) */ false,"
    assert t.count(old) == 1, name
    p.write_text(t.replace(old, "/* FAULT CONTROL: rail half on Attention GPUs */ not afd_holder,"))
print("control patched", sys.argv[1])
